title: Lab - Backup and restore
description: Take an etcd snapshot, destroy something, restore it.
scenario: Take an etcd snapshot, destroy something, restore it. This lab is a skeleton: the tasks name what to do and how to check it; work them on your own cluster and expand your notes as you go.
environment_setup:
# A three-node kind cluster is enough for this lab
cat <<'EOF' > kind-cka.yaml
kind: Cluster
apiVersion: kind.x-k8s.io/v1alpha4
name: cka
nodes:
  - role: control-plane
  - role: worker
  - role: worker
EOF
kind create cluster --config kind-cka.yaml
kubectl get nodes
cleanup:
kind delete cluster --name cka
rm -f kind-cka.yaml

tasks.title: Task 1 - Snapshot
tasks.instructions: Save a snapshot of etcd to /opt/snapshot-pre-boot.db using the correct endpoints and certificates.

tasks.title: Task 2 - Break
tasks.instructions: Delete every Deployment and Service in the default namespace.

tasks.title: Task 3 - Restore
tasks.instructions: Restore the snapshot to a new data dir and point the etcd static Pod at it.
tasks.solution:
etcdutl snapshot restore /opt/snapshot-pre-boot.db --data-dir /var/lib/etcd-from-backup
# edit /etc/kubernetes/manifests/etcd.yaml hostPath to the new dir
tasks.verification: kubectl get all  # the Deployments are back
